figurative_meaning_bn: প্রবলভীতির কারণে মানসিক বিপর্যয়; ভীতির আতিশয্যে কাঁপা
figurative_meaning_en: Mental distress caused by intense fear; trembling excessively due to terror
example_sentences_in_english: The soldiers are shivering in terror from the attack.
note: This idiom vividly captures the physical manifestation of extreme fear in Bengali expressive tradition.
